pairs.english: On the slope back to the academy,
Tavi ran into Iven.
Iven was just on his way down the slope,

pairs.target: shǒulǐ niē zhe liǎngzhāng yíyàng dà de zhǐ .
pairs.english: clutching two sheets of exactly the same size in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 手里捏着两张一样大的纸。

pairs.english: He recognized Tavi,

pairs.target: xiān bǎ zhǐ wǎng shēnhòu yì cáng ,
pairs.english: first hid the papers behind his back,
and then laughed himself.

pairs.target: nǐ bié cāi nǎ zhāng shì zhēnde . "
pairs.english: “You need not guess which one is real,”
he said.
“Both of them are real.”

pairs.target: yìzhāng shì guì kǒu shōuqián de píngjù ,
pairs.english: One was proof of payment at the counter,
pairs.hanzi: 一张是柜口收钱的凭据，

pairs.target: lìng yìzhāng shì bànshì de rén qiān de shōutiáo .
pairs.english: and the other was a receipt signed by the person doing the work.
pairs.hanzi: 另一张是办事的人签的收条。

pairs.target: yīwén zhōngyú dé zhǔn zài zhuōbiān duì zhe yuánjiàn chāo ,
pairs.english: Iven had finally been allowed to sit at the table and copy from the originals.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文终于得准在桌边对着原件抄，

pairs.english: He was not allowed to take the ledger away.

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngzhāng chāojiàn dìgěi tǎ wéi kàn ,
pairs.english: He handed the two copies to Tavi to look at,
pairs.hanzi: 他把两张抄件递给塔维看，

pairs.english: and asked him, if he saw only the first,

pairs.target: huì buhuì yǐwéi qián yǐ dàoshǒu .
pairs.english: would he think the money had already reached the recipient?
Tavi didn't answer.

pairs.target: xiān wèn tā wèishénme hái wǎngxiàzǒu .
pairs.english: First he asked him why he was still going downhill.
pairs.hanzi: 先问他为什么还往下走。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō shǎo chāo le shōutiáo bèimiàn yíjù huà ,
pairs.english: Iven said he'd missed copying a line on the back of the receipt.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说少抄了收条背面一句话，

pairs.target: xiǎng gǎn zài guì kǒu guānmén qián huíqù .
pairs.english: He wanted to get back to the counter before it closed.
pairs.hanzi: 想赶在柜口关门前回去。

pairs.english: Tavi looked up at the sky.
The sun was still high,

pairs.target: kě guì kǒu shénme shíhòu guān ,
pairs.english: but as for when the counter closed,
he didn't know at all, not in the slightest.
He moved away to the side,
letting Iven pass first.
After a few steps,
Iven stopped again.
He asked Tavi,

pairs.target: ruò zìjǐ jīnrì yòu méichāo qí ,
pairs.english: if he still hadn't finished copying it today,
would he still wait for dinner?

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō děngdào dìyī guō fàn màiwán .
pairs.english: Tavi said he'd wait until the first pot of rice sold out.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说等到第一锅饭卖完。

pairs.english: Iven objected that this wasn't a precise time.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ jiù shǒu zhe mài fàn de rén ,
pairs.english: Tavi said he himself would stay by the person selling rice,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己就守着卖饭的人，

pairs.english: and guaranteed he'd see the bottom of the pot.

pairs.target: yīwén xiào zhe wǎng xià pǎo ,
pairs.english: Iven laughed and ran downhill,

pairs.target: zhǐ zài shǒulǐ pāi dé xiǎng .
pairs.english: the paper flapping quite loudly in his hand.
Tavi returned to the classroom

pairs.target: jiāng péng ménbiān jiá zhǐ de bànfǎ jìxiàlái ,
pairs.english: and noted down the way the sheets were clipped by the shelter door.
pairs.hanzi: 将棚门边夹纸的办法记下来，

pairs.target: yòu zài pángbiān lìng xiě yìháng :
pairs.english: Beside it he wrote one more line:
A note having been seen

pairs.target: bù děngyú gāi kàn de rén kànguò .
pairs.english: doesn't mean the person meant to see it has done so.
His writing filled up too much space,

pairs.target: mò yígè zì jǐ dào le zhé fèngshàng .
pairs.english: and the last character crowded onto the fold.
pairs.hanzi: 末一个字挤到了折缝上。

pairs.target: mǐlā cóng tā jiān hòu tàntóu ,
pairs.english: Mira peered over his shoulder

pairs.target: shuō nǐ dǎo búyòng bǎ tā xiě dé xiàng qiànzhàng .
pairs.english: and said, “You don't need to write it as if you owed money.”
pairs.hanzi: 说你倒不用把它写得像欠账。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngzhāng xìng zhōu de zhǐ jiǎng gěi tā tīng .
pairs.english: He told her about the two notes for people named Zhou.
pairs.hanzi: 他把两张姓周的纸讲给她听。

pairs.target: mǐlā tīng le yíbàn jiù qù ná zìjǐ de tú ,
pairs.english: Mira was halfway through listening when she went for her own drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉听了一半就去拿自己的图，

pairs.english: When she brought them back,
she also had a short length of thread in her hand.

pairs.target: tā yòng duǎnxiàn bǎ liǎngzhāng xiūdìng tú jì zài yìqǐ ,
pairs.english: She used the short thread to tie the two revision drawings up together,
pairs.hanzi: 她用短线把两张修订图系在一起，

pairs.target: shuō sū yǐ ruò zhǐ kànjiàn xīn de ,
pairs.english: and said if Suyi saw only the new one,

pairs.target: kěnéng huì yǐwéi jiù de nàge kǒng gēnběn méi mó piān .
pairs.english: she might think the hole on the old one had never worn off center at all.
pairs.hanzi: 可能会以为旧的那个孔根本没磨偏。

pairs.target: tā yuánběn dǎsuàn zhī jì yìzhāng ,
pairs.english: She had originally meant to send just one sheet,
so the postage could be a little less.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā yào buyào zìjǐ chū nà yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if she wanted him to pay the difference.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问她要不要自己出那一点。

pairs.english: Mira said no.
She was the one who had counted the money wrong,
not him owing her anything.

pairs.target: yào bāng jiù tì tā bǎ tú zhé xiǎo xiē ,
pairs.english: If he wanted to help, then fold her drawings down a little smaller,
pairs.hanzi: 要帮就替她把图折小些，

pairs.english: but don't fold across the holes.
He found a clean spot on the table,
and offset the two drawings by half an inch.
He folded them once, then opened them again.

pairs.target: yuánlái zhǐyào jiāng tú zhuǎn gè fāngxiàng ,
pairs.english: It turned out he only had to turn the drawings in a different direction
pairs.hanzi: 原来只要将图转个方向，

pairs.target: zhéhén biàn néng bìkāi liǎngchù kǒng .
pairs.english: for the crease to miss both holes.
Mira took them back
and had a look.

pairs.target: bìng bù kuā tā huì zhézhǐ ,
pairs.english: She didn't praise his paper folding skills.
She just handed the short thread back
and asked him to tie it one more time.

pairs.target: nà shì tā dǎ de jié ,
pairs.english: That was the knot she had tied.
Tavi was halfway through untying it,

pairs.target: tā yě méi shēnshǒu jiēguò qù .
pairs.english: and she still didn't reach over to take it from him.
